In [8]:
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6)) ##Distribution of Salaries with histogram
plt.hist(em['Salary'], bins=5, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black')
plt.xlabel('Salary') 
plt.ylabel('Frequency')  
plt.title('Distribution of Salaries') 
plt.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.75) 
plt.show()
In [12]:
avg_salary = em.groupby('Department')['Salary'].mean().reset_index()
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6)) 
plt.bar(avg_salary['Department'], avg_salary['Salary'], color='skyblue') 
plt.xlabel('Department') 
plt.ylabel('Average Salary') 
plt.title('Average Salaries Across Departments')  
plt.xticks(rotation=45)  
plt.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.75)   ##Average Salaries Across Departments with bar chart
plt.show()

gender_counts = em['Gender'].value_counts()
plt.figure(figsize=(3, 3))  
plt.pie(gender_counts, labels=gender_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        startangle=140, colors=['green', 'yellow'])  
plt.axis('equal') 
plt.title('Gender Distribution within the Company') 
plt.show()  #Gender Distribution within the Company wthi Pie chart
